doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 进一步增强轻工业繁荣市场、扩大就业、服务“三农”的支柱产业地位
quote_en: Further strengthen the pillar-industry role of light industry in prospering markets, creating jobs and serving agriculture.
notes: Headline of a dedicated plan; broad concept (spans 家用电器, 轻工制造, 食品饮料, 纺织服饰, 基础化工 etc.) -> none. Restrictions recorded in sub-sector rows (淘汰落后产能, 严格控制新增产能, 食品加工安全专项).

doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 进一步扩大“家电下乡”补贴品种
quote_en: Further widen the range of products under the rural home-appliance subsidy programme.
notes: Named programme; microwave ovens and induction cookers added. Restriction side: 淘汰低能效冰箱3000万台, CFC-foamed refrigerators; 家电行业重点产品向中西部转移 (guided relocation).

doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加快实施节能灯替代，淘汰6亿只白炽灯产能
quote_en: Speed up replacement by energy-saving lamps and eliminate 600 million incandescent lamps of capacity.
notes: Quantitative target. Support side: 新型节能环保光源 technology breakthroughs (list item).

doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加快造纸、家电、塑料、照明电器等行业技术改造步伐
quote_en: Speed up technical upgrading in paper, appliances, plastics, lighting and other industries.
notes: Support: 造纸装备, 技改, 林纸一体化 (+2.2 Mt wood pulp, +0.3 Mt bamboo pulp). Restriction: 淘汰落后制浆造纸200万吨以上, straw-pulp lines below 34,000 t, waste-paper mills below 10,000 t closed. Dominant = support by clause count (judgement).

doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 大力整顿食品加工企业
notes: Named programme 食品加工安全专项: 坚决取缔无证非法生产加工企业, 提高食品行业准入门槛, 建立召回及退市制度. Support side: 农副产品深加工, 食品行业节能减排技改, 食品装备自给率60%. Dominant = regulatory (judgement).

doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划
concept_zh: 发酵行业（酒精、味精、柠檬酸）
quote_zh: 食品行业重点淘汰年产3万吨以下酒精、味精生产工艺及装置
quote_en: The food sector will eliminate alcohol and MSG processes and units below 30,000 t a year.
notes: Target also lists 酒精100万吨、味精12万吨、柠檬酸5万吨 capacity to be scrapped; 推进陶瓷和发酵行业向有原料优势地区转移.

doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 新增花生油100万吨、菜籽油100万吨、棉籽油50万吨、特色油脂100万吨产能
quote_en: Add 1 Mt peanut oil, 1 Mt rapeseed oil, 0.5 Mt cottonseed oil and 1 Mt specialty oil capacity.
notes: Quantitative capacity target (保障食用植物油供给安全).

doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 进一步扩大食糖国家储备
quote_en: Further enlarge the national sugar reserve.
notes: Also 糖能联产 technology support and 制糖 in the list of specialised markets.

doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 皮革行业重点淘汰年加工3万标张以下的生产线
quote_en: The leather industry will eliminate lines processing under 30,000 standard hides a year.
notes: Target: 3 million standard hides of capacity scrapped. Also 引导制革和制鞋行业集中的东部沿海地区… (relocation); clean-production support. L2 mapping is a judgement.

doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 电池行业重点淘汰汞含量高于1ppm的圆柱形碱锰电池和汞含量高于5ppm的扣式碱锰电池
quote_en: The battery sector will eliminate cylindrical alkaline-manganese cells with mercury above 1 ppm and button cells above 5 ppm.
notes: Target: 9 billion mercury-containing button cells of capacity scrapped; also 普通锌锰电池实现无汞、无铅、无镉化.

doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 锂离子电池替代镉镍电池
quote_en: Lithium-ion batteries to replace nickel-cadmium batteries.
notes: Also 新能源电池 key-technology breakthroughs (list item) and national engineering centre for batteries.

doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 支持塑料行业绿色塑料建材、多功能宽幅农膜生产技术升级
quote_en: Support technical upgrading of green plastic building materials and multifunctional wide agricultural film.
notes: Also plastic-forming equipment and 塑料降解 standards.

doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 支持表面活性剂行业推广应用绿色表面活性剂
quote_en: Support the promotion of green surfactants in the surfactant industry.

doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 支持五金行业传统加工工艺及设备升级
quote_en: Support upgrading of traditional processing technology and equipment in the hardware industry.
notes: L2 none: hardware/metal products have no clear SW L2 here.

doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 推进陶瓷和发酵行业向有原料优势、能源丰富的地区转移
quote_en: Promote relocation of the ceramics and fermentation industries to regions with raw-material and energy advantages.
notes: Guided relocation (产业有序转移). L2 mapping is a judgement.

doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 造纸装备重点发展大幅宽、高车速造纸成套设备
quote_en: Paper-making equipment will focus on wide-web, high-speed complete sets.
notes: Also 食品装备, 塑料成型装备, 工业缝制装备 bullets; target: food-equipment self-sufficiency 60%.
